contentList.content: A child of chaos unbound by predetermined fate. Master every weapon, armour, and all eighteen skills, and begin with seven spells. No Digital Deluxe items are granted.
Toggle this origin identity and its abilities unlocked at your current level independently. Multiple identities may be enabled together. Cannot be changed in combat.
Become Blinded for 1 turn: ranged attacks are limited to 3 m, attacks have Disadvantage, and attacks against it have Advantage.

Lasts 1 turn. Randomly selects Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder; damage of that type is doubled. The Chaos Lost stack remains after this temporary penalty ends.

Each negative Chaos Wound result deepens Chaos Lost by 1 and attempts to turn it into Chaos Power. A success resets Lost to 0; resting cannot reduce it. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_LOST">View conversion chances</LSTag>.
Chaos Lost: 5/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 35%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 50%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
The original target and nearest enemy each take the full wheel damage. If no other enemy exists, the original target takes it twice.
Become Vulnerable to Fire for 1 turn, doubling incoming Fire damage.
The wheel damage is devoured by the void and deals no further damage.
Chaos Lost: 3/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 15%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 25%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Character levels 1–2: the next attack roll takes a −8 penalty; if it still hits, its final damage is doubled. Removed after a hit or miss.

Ten results, each lasting 1 turn: Bless, Haste, Blur, Heroism, Invisibility, Melee Advantage, Ranged Advantage, Spell Advantage, restoring the damage just taken, or Bloodlust. Bloodlust grants 1 Action and 5 temporary Hit Points on the first kill that turn; Haste causes no Lethargy when it ends.
Chaos Lost: 1/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 5%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 10%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.

The current complete attack or damaging spell automatically hits and doubles its final total damage on resolution. An attack roll of 20 can still critically hit, allowing critical damage to be doubled again. Removed after the complete action or spell resolves.
The wheel damage doubles, then is split among the original target and all enemies within 6 m.
Become Wet for 1 turn: gain Fire Resistance, but become Vulnerable to Cold and Lightning.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Psychic damage.

Negative Wound results add 1 Lost. Conversion chances at stacks 1–10 are 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 35%, 50%, 65%, 80%, 90%, and 100%. On success, gain 1 Power 90% of the time, 2 Power 8%, or 3 Power 2%, then reset Lost to 0. Positive results and Wet add no Lost.
The wheel damage doubles and strikes the original target.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Acid damage.

Direct damage can awaken Chaos Echo, with equal odds to deal bonus Force damage or heal the damaged target if it survives. Each target rolls independently. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_ECHO">View Echo progression</LSTag>.
Chaos Lost: 6/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 50%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 65%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Become Vulnerable to Poison for 1 turn, doubling incoming Poison damage.
Become Vulnerable to Force for 1 turn, doubling incoming Force damage.
The wheel damage returns unchanged to the original target.
The wheel damage doubles, then strikes either the original target or a random enemy within 12 m.
Become Vulnerable to Lightning for 1 turn, doubling incoming Lightning damage.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Advantage.

When an attack is about to resolve, force it toward a single outcome: attack rolls count as 20, damaging saving-throw spells make their targets fail, and the final damage is doubled. Critical hits stack with this multiplier. Unlocked at level 12; once per Short Rest.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Thunder damage.
For 1 turn: immunity to Frightened and 5 temporary hit points.
Chaos Lost: 9/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 90%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 100%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.

Twin Rift (6%): split between the target and nearest enemy. Chain Fission (5%): split among the target and up to 2 nearest enemies. Mistaken Target (5%): moves to the nearest enemy. Random Prey (3%): moves to a random enemy within 12 m. If no other target exists, the original target takes it.
Half the wheel damage resolves immediately; the other half resolves at the start of the original target's next turn.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Fire damage.
Become Slowed for 1 turn, halving Movement Speed.
For 1 turn: +9 m Movement, +2 Armour Class, 1 additional Action, and Advantage on Dexterity saves. It causes no Lethargy when it ends.
Chaos Lost: 4/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 25%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 35%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Force damage.
Take 2d6 extra damage of a random type.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Lightning damage.
Become Poisoned for 1 turn, gaining Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Disadvantage.

Tear open chaos and reshape the current turn. Fully restore Hit Points, remove harmful conditions, and recover Action, Bonus Action, and Movement. Then gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_GENESIS">Chaos Genesis</LSTag> and one <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_KILL">Chaos Finisher</LSTag>.

Twin Pulse (4%): half resolves now and half at the start of the target's next turn. Twin-Time Echo (2%): full wheel damage resolves now and again at the start of the target's next turn. Void Devouring (8%): the wheel damage vanishes. Genesis Riftstrike (2.5%): the original target takes 4 times the wheel damage.

From the start of one of your turns until the start of your next turn, the first enemy or ally attack or spell that damages you draws one equally likely <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_WOUND_NEGATIVE">negative result</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_WOUND_POSITIVE">positive result</LSTag>, or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="WET">Wet</LSTag>. Only enemy-caused negative results deepen Chaos Lost and attempt to gain Chaos Power. Immunity to the drawn condition does not permit another draw during that cycle.
The original target and nearest enemy split the wheel damage. If no other enemy exists, the original target takes it all.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Advantage.
Character levels 3–6: the next attack roll takes a −6 penalty; if it still hits, its final damage is doubled. Removed after a hit or miss.
The original target takes the full wheel damage now and the same damage again at the start of its next turn.

Attack penalty: −8 at levels 1–2, −6 at levels 3–6, and −4 at levels 7–12. Uses: 1 at levels 1–4, 2 at levels 5–8, and 3 from level 9. Short Rest, Long Rest, or a Restoration Pod restores all uses. All-In only affects attacks with attack rolls; it neither changes the attack die nor forces a critical hit.
Become Mad and uncontrollable for 1 turn.

Fifteen results, each lasting 1 turn: Madness, Frightened, Stunned, Silenced, Prone, Blinded, Slowed, Poisoned, Bleeding, Burning, Melee Disadvantage, Ranged Disadvantage, Spell Disadvantage, Vulnerability to one random damage type, or an extra 2d6 damage of a random type. Allied attacks can draw these results but add no Chaos Lost and make no Chaos Power roll. Self-damage, falling, surfaces, and damage-over-time do not trigger it.
The wheel damage vanishes for now and resolves at the start of the original target's next turn.
Become Vulnerable to Cold for 1 turn, doubling incoming Cold damage.
For 1 turn: immunity to Frightened and 5 temporary hit points.
Gain Blur for 1 turn: attacks against it have Disadvantage.

Half of your direct damage resolves normally; the other half enters the Chaos Wheel. Each target draws its own change, and the wheel can never harm you. Results are divided into <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_DUALITY_FLOW">Return and Dislocation</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_DUALITY_RIFT">Rifts and Transfer</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_DUALITY_REWRITE">Rewrite and Burst</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_DUALITY_EXTREME">Echoes and Extremes</LSTag>.
Immediately restore Hit Points equal to the triggering damage, up to maximum Hit Points.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Disadvantage.
Chaos Lost: 0/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 0%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 5%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.

Chaos gains the identity tags of every official playable race and all seven origin characters, unlocking their abilities by character level. Level 1: Astarion's Bite, Wyll's Blade of Frontiers, and Karlach's starting traits; level 3: Dark Urge Stealth Expertise and Karlach's first upgrade; level 5: Gale's Netherese shadow slot and summon, Karlach's Infernal Fury, and Dark Urge's bleeding dagger; level 7: Wyll's Fire Shield and Karlach's second upgrade; level 9: Dark Urge Slayer form; level 10: Astarion's Vampire Ascendant; level 11: Wyll's cambion summon; level 12: Astarion's bat form. Racial spells unlock at their original levels.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Disadvantage.

Stake accuracy on the next weapon or spell attack. If it still hits, its final damage is doubled; a critical hit stacks with this multiplier. The effect ends after the attack hits or misses. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COR_CHAOS_RULE_ALLIN">View All-In progression</LSTag>.

Damage Rewrite (5%): double the wheel damage against the original target. Twin-Target Rewrite (4%): the original target and nearest enemy each take the full wheel damage. Hostile Burst (3%): double it, then split it among the target and enemies within 6 m. Chaos Verdict (1%): double it, then strike the original target or a random enemy within 12 m.
All wheel damage moves to a random enemy within 12 m. If no other enemy exists, the original target still takes it.
The original target and up to 2 nearest enemies split the wheel damage.
Your next complete melee attack action or damaging spell automatically hits and critically hits; damaging saving-throw spells double their damage dice. Consumed after the action or spell resolves.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage.
Become Stunned for 1 turn: cannot act or react, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against it have Advantage.

Condensed Chaos Power. Every 3 Power enables one Chaos Genesis, and unused Power remains until spent. A successful Chaos Lost conversion grants 1 Power 90% of the time, 2 Power 8%, or 3 Power 2%. A successful kill roll grants 1 Power 70% of the time, 2 Power 20%, or 3 Power 10%.
Become Vulnerable to Psychic for 1 turn, doubling incoming Psychic damage.
Become Silenced for 1 turn and cannot cast spells with verbal components.
Chaos Lost: 8/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 80%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 90%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Chaos Lost: 10/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 100%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 100%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
The wheel damage vanishes for now; the original target takes it at the start of the caster's next turn.
For 1 turn, the first enemy killed grants 1 Action and 5 temporary hit points. Triggers once per status and never replaces Elixir of Bloodlust.
Burn for 1 turn, taking 1d4 Fire damage each turn.

Chaos Return (21.25%): the wheel damage returns unchanged to the target. Elemental Dislocation (17.25%): the same amount becomes a random damage type. Delayed Echo (7%): resolves at the start of the target's next turn. Temporal Afterecho (6%): resolves at the start of the caster's next turn.
Become Prone for 1 turn and must stand before moving.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Disadvantage.
Become Frightened for 1 turn: cannot move and has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Gain Bless for 1 turn: add 1d4 to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
The wheel damage keeps its total amount, changes to a random damage type, and strikes the original target.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Poison damage.
Become Vulnerable to Acid for 1 turn, doubling incoming Acid damage.
Chaos Echo healed the damaged target.
Chaos Lost: 7/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 65%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 80%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Become Vulnerable to Thunder for 1 turn, doubling incoming Thunder damage.
All wheel damage moves to the nearest enemy. If no other enemy exists, the original target still takes it.
Bleed for 1 turn: take 2 Slashing damage each turn and have Disadvantage on Constitution saves.
Become Invisible for 1 turn: attacks have Advantage and attacks against it have Disadvantage. Attacking or casting a spell ends it early.
Become Vulnerable to Necrotic for 1 turn, doubling incoming Necrotic damage.
For 1 turn, the first enemy killed grants 1 Action and 5 temporary hit points. Triggers once per status and never replaces Elixir of Bloodlust.
For 1 turn: +9 m Movement, +2 Armour Class, 1 additional Action, and Advantage on Dexterity saves. It causes no Lethargy when it ends.
The original target takes 4 times the wheel damage.
Unites every official racial identity and racial power while enduring unpredictable shifts of chaos.
Character levels 7–12: the next attack roll takes a −4 penalty; if it still hits, its final damage is doubled. Removed after a hit or miss.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Advantage.
Chaos Lost: 2/10. The current chance to gain Chaos Power is 10%; after the next negative Chaos Wound result it becomes 15%. A success resets the count to 0, and resting does not reduce it.
Chaos Echo dealt bonus Force damage.
For 1 turn, the corresponding attacks have Advantage.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Radiant damage.

For 1 turn: gain 2 additional Actions; spell slots and Warlock spell slots are not spent; unlock Flight; ignore opportunity attacks; become immune to Prone and difficult terrain; Movement is not reduced; each melee attack deals an additional 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, and Thunder damage, for 10d6 total.

Levels 1–5: 10% trigger, dealing 10% of final damage as bonus Force damage or healing 5%. Levels 6–9: 30% trigger, 20% bonus damage or 10% healing. Level 10+: 50% trigger, 30% bonus damage or 20% healing. Both results are equally likely; bonus damage cannot trigger Chaos Echo again.
Immediately take an extra 2d6 Cold damage.
Become Vulnerable to Radiant for 1 turn, doubling incoming Radiant damage.
The current character is neither the Chaos origin nor the Chaos race.
Only the host can change Chaos Origin settings.
Proficiency and Expertise in All 18 Skills

These switches affect only the currently controlled Chaos character and are stored in the save. All settings are locked in combat; disabling a mechanic immediately removes the abilities granted by this mod.

Each of the seven origin identities can be toggled independently, and multiple identities may be enabled together. Each grants its official origin tag and level-gated abilities and may alter story checks. They cannot be changed in combat.
Gain proficiency and expertise in all eighteen skills, scaling with the normal proficiency bonus. No fixed +5 bonus is added.
Gain proficiency with light, medium, and heavy armour, shields, simple and martial weapons, and musical instruments.
Gain Booming Blade, Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Feather Fall, Jump, and Disguise Self.
The controlled character changed; the setting was not applied.
Chaos settings cannot be changed in combat.
